svg.text: Every approved text and surface combination, shown live with its measured WCAG contrast.
The AA bars are 4.5 to 1 for normal text and 3 to 1 for large text and UI shapes. Anything not listed is not sanctioned.
Default text on the page background. Any size.
Text inside white cards. Any size.
Pill chips and soft callouts. Any size.
Nav pills and secondary surfaces. Any size.
Inputs and inactive pill states. Any size.
The brand CTA pairing. Any size.
Success text on the page; 7.9 on white cards.
Danger text on the page; 7.1 on white cards.
Warning on a yellow-tinted field; 5.4 on the page.
Below AA for small text. Keep short, prefer #8A5A00.
Button labels inside solid navy actions only.
The cinematic dark hero. Brand only, used sparingly.
Dark featured cards. Never pure white for content.
Ink ramp floors, measured on the page
Headlines and focused input text. Any text.
Body copy and emphasis. Any text.
Secondary body and labels; a hair under AA on the page, 4.6 on cards.
Icon strokes, placeholders, disabled states. Never text.
Unreadable. Yellow is a surface and an accent, never text on light.
The decorative sub-palette never carries text.
Semantic colors sit on light neutrals or carry white. Never teal on yellow.
Never two tones from the middle or top of the range.
Known gaps, logged in the tracker: inline warning #A96B00 measures 4.02 on the page at its built 12px size.
60 percent ink measures 4.47 on the page, just under the 4.5 bar; it passes on white cards (4.6). Prefer 80 percent on the page.
